mapper.sql: k.kb_id, k.tenant_id, k.kb_name, k.description, k.embedding_model, k.status, k.create_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_document d WHERE d.kb_id = k.kb_id) AS doc_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM kb_knowledge_base k WHERE k.kb_id = #{kbId}
SELECT FROM kb_knowledge_base k ORDER BY k.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_knowledge_base (tenant_id, kb_name, description, embedding_model, status, create_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{kbName}, #{description}, #{embeddingModel}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_knowledge_base SET status = #{status} WHERE kb_id = #{kbId}
UPDATE kb_knowledge_base SET embedding_model = #{embeddingModel} WHERE kb_id = #{kbId}
